notes:
# FMC Media PC 0.2.10

- Arabic Sources now uses a three-column grid with one vertical scroll area. Matching titles, playback hosts, quality buttons and subtitle labels stay inside each provider card.
- Added title/type/year and found / need-a-pick / nothing counts, with distinct text and border states for successful matches, ambiguous versions and unavailable providers.
- Matching versions appear as ranked buttons. Explicit choices are remembered; equivalent version lists can apply a selection to both providers using each provider's own work ID.
- Searches verified English, romaji, Japanese and alternative AniList names after the initial name cannot be matched. Alternative names can also be searched on a single provider.
- Fixed anime films with a single playback episode being mistaken for series. Added verified movie handling for provider entries named Film or numbered zero.
- Your Name. (2016) now matches AnimeRift, WitAnime, Anime4up, Anime Slayer, AnimeSlayer Web and Animeify. Provider protections, removed files and unsupported hosts are shown separately from catalog matches.
